en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Candles hung on the walls...
They're the only source of light in the room.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's no window in this room, so if you
blew out the candles, it'd be pitch-dark.

<CLT=cltMIND>Candles hung on the walls...
They're the only source of light in the room.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's no window in this room, so if you
blew out the candles, it'd be pitch-dark.

<CLT=cltMIND>It seems these floorboards are layered on
top of <CLT=cltSTRONG>crosspieces<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps that's why the floor isn't
entirely stable...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's also a hole in the corner of the room.
I shouldn't walk too close to there...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...
